name: ogv_discharge_commits_every_statement
setup_sql: INSERT INTO vessels (id, name) VALUES ('v-1', 'NORD STAR')
INSERT INTO holds (id, vessel_id, hold_no, volume_m3) VALUES ('h-1', 'v-1', 1, 100000)
INSERT INTO cargoes (id, name) VALUES ('c-1', 'Wheat')
INSERT INTO voyages (id, vessel_id, voyage_no) VALUES ('voy-1', 'v-1', 'B-1')

INSERT INTO cargo_lots (id, voyage_id, source_vessel, cargo_id, hold_id, sf, planned_tons, loaded_tons, load_sequence, loaded_at) VALUES ('lot-1', 'voy-1', 'DIANA MARIA', 'c-1', 'h-1', 1.25, 1600, 1600, 1, '2026-05-01T00:00:00Z')

INSERT INTO cargo_lots (id, voyage_id, source_vessel, cargo_id, hold_id, sf, planned_tons, loaded_tons, load_sequence, loaded_at) VALUES ('lot-2', 'voy-1', 'VELES', 'c-1', 'h-1', 1.25, 1200, 1200, 2, '2026-05-01T01:00:00Z')
INSERT INTO cargo_layers (id, cargo_lot_id, voyage_id, hold_id, source_vessel, loaded_tons, remaining_tons, load_sequence) VALUES ('layer-1', 'lot-1', 'voy-1', 'h-1', 'DIANA MARIA', 1600, 1600, 1)
INSERT INTO cargo_layers (id, cargo_lot_id, voyage_id, hold_id, source_vessel, loaded_tons, remaining_tons, load_sequence) VALUES ('layer-2', 'lot-2', 'voy-1', 'h-1', 'VELES', 1200, 1200, 2)

batch.sql: INSERT INTO operations (id, voyage_id, type, event_date, source_hold, tons) VALUES (?, ?, 'discharge', ?, ?, ?)
INSERT INTO discharge_allocations (id, operation_id, cargo_layer_id, cargo_lot_id, hold_id, source_vessel, discharged_tons) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
INSERT INTO discharge_allocations (id, operation_id, cargo_layer_id, cargo_lot_id, hold_id, source_vessel, discharged_tons) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
UPDATE cargo_layers SET remaining_tons = ?, layer_status = ? WHERE id = ? AND remaining_tons = ?
UPDATE cargo_layers SET remaining_tons = ?, layer_status = ? WHERE id = ? AND remaining_tons = ?

assert_sql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM operations) AS operations, (SELECT count(*) FROM discharge_allocations) AS allocations, (SELECT count(*) FROM audit_log WHERE entity_type IN ('operations', 'discharge_allocations') OR (entity_type = 'cargo_layers' AND action = 'update')) AS batch_audit, (SELECT CAST(remaining_tons AS INTEGER) FROM cargo_layers WHERE id = 'layer-1') AS layer_1_remaining, (SELECT CAST(remaining_tons AS INTEGER) FROM cargo_layers WHERE id = 'layer-2') AS layer_2_remaining
